grammar.frequency_rule_count: exactly the number of rules the predictive grammar accepted
grammar.learn_from: D0 Fit rows and their labels only

route_classification.sign_convention: delta_discovery = RMSE(FREQ_GRAMMAR) - RMSE(PRED_GRAMMAR); delta_port = RMSE(PRED_PORT_MEAN) - RMSE(PRED_GRAMMAR); positive = PRED_GRAMMAR better

target.name: whole_molecule_lipophilicity
target.normalization: fit-only z-score of the D0 Fit rows

word.matching: greedy maximal matching of a rule's occurrences, ordered by exact canonical atom ranks
word.partition: every atom covered exactly once; every real bond is internal or inter-word
